senses.gloss: f. (denom. of דְּקַן; adopted in Hebr.) trimming shears on a pole.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:10">Y. Maasr. III, end, 51ᵃ</cite> <he>היתה ניטלת בד׳</he> if the fruit is taken off with trimming shears (by a person standing outside the garden).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:10">Ib.</cite> <he>צור צור דּוּקְנִיתָךְ וכ׳</he> wrap well up (keep well thy question about) the pruner (sophistical as it is), it is better than anything (the Agadists have to say).—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 9</cite> <he>האיזמל של די׳</he> one knife of the shears.
